findings.title: Systemic hardcoding regresses templated deploy flow
findings.summary: Every deployable value baked as a literal in hand-written static units; must be rendered from manifests/*.

findings.title: R2 coordinates decomposed but still literal in-unit
findings.summary: No EnvironmentFile single-source; host/port/db still baked.

findings.title: Static quadlets hardcode identity and topology
findings.summary: UID/GID, ports, ~8 URLs, mounts, dependency graph all literal.

findings.title: litellm template carries no Jinja, duplicates unit
findings.summary: Byte-identical to static quadlet; pick one owner.

findings.title: Upgrade re-land skips pack service configs and SAN
findings.summary: Pack configs re-owned not re-copied; cert top-up skips existing so new logstash SAN not applied to installed hosts.

findings.title: LME_FORCE_CERT_REMINT lacks auto-clear guard
findings.summary: Left set re-mints every pass; setup non-idempotent.

findings.title: debian_13.yml comment-only causes empty-task warning
findings.summary: Ansible warns on empty task file each Debian-13 run.

findings.title: Tailscale idempotency uses brittle substring match
findings.summary: Format-fragile stdout matching.

findings.title: Cert 0640 breaks non-idmap key-reading consumers
findings.summary: Five default-path idmap units get 0640 keys but no User=root compensation; potential crash-loop regression.

findings.title: no_log on litellm render now guards no secret
findings.summary: Hides render errors, protects nothing.

findings.title: pgvector password moved to podman secret at rest
findings.summary: R1 win confirmed; residual coordinates still literal.

findings.title: CA signing key MITM only half closed
findings.summary: Four User=root consumers with no UserNS= read ca.key regardless of chmod 600; PR expands root set 2 to 4.

findings.title: Teardown never removes /etc/lme vault store
findings.summary: Vault password pass.sh and secrets survive wipe; post-teardown secret recovery.

findings.title: Beats 5044 exposed tailnet-wide unauthenticated
findings.summary: tailscale serve --tcp=5044 with client-cert auth commented out.

findings.title: LITELLM_API_KEY cleartext at rest in units
findings.summary: sk-lme-llama-proxy baked into Environment=.

findings.title: metricbeat mounts host root and runs as root
findings.summary: /:/hostfs:ro + root can read host vault password.

findings.title: gitignore un-ignores non-Chapter lme.conf
findings.summary: Broadens tracked logstash config surface.

findings.title: Non-interactive plumbing complete for single-node
findings.summary: compute_effective_flags unified; sudo -v remains a non-root-ssh hazard mooted over tailscale root.

findings.title: Cluster ES memory backstop is single-node only
findings.summary: Both guards gate on single-node; cluster renders uncapped+mlocked; master OOMs on 16 GB.

findings.title: Offline no-llm lands litellm with missing secret
findings.summary: Secret=pgvector on unconditionally-copied unit; secret created only on install_llm path; podman run fails.

findings.title: No inventory-driven teardown for clusters
findings.summary: Node-local only; setup-deploy-teardown loop closed for single-node only.

findings.title: graphroot relocation to /data is unguarded
findings.summary: Default /var; nothing detects graph 11G /var; no preflight.

findings.title: cluster plus offline rejected, no airgapped-cluster path
findings.summary: Hard reject blocks that matrix cell; no single-command path.

findings.title: Teardown cannot self-verify or fail on residue
findings.summary: Every op || true, unconditional exit 0, prints Wipe complete on a dirty host; e2e gate cannot fail.

findings.title: Unquoted systemctl stop lme glob stops two units
findings.summary: From repo root expands to lme-dashboard lme-log-analyzer; most services never stop; volume rm can fail.

findings.title: Upgrade verify passes 5-10 of 11 as success
findings.summary: AI stack OOM on 16 GB passes as false success; no per-container health assertion.

findings.title: Wipe cleans rootless config on rootful install
findings.summary: rm -rf ~/.config/containers misleading on rootful stack.

findings.title: No expiry observability on internal CA mesh
findings.summary: No renewal/expiry signal on minted mesh certs.

findings.title: Cluster and convert path run ES with no heap cap
findings.summary: Sets es_discovery_type cluster with zero heap/memory handling; converts capped single-node into uncapped cluster node on 16 GB.

findings.title: No operator override knob for ES heap or memory
findings.summary: es_heap_size/es_memory_max undefined in all defaults/vars/docs; sibling storage_graphroot got full plumbing.

findings.title: No CPU caps and no aggregate memory budget
findings.summary: Two uncapped inference servers plus LiteLLM contend with ES/Logstash on 12 threads.

findings.title: No committed validation targets this branch
findings.summary: Zero test/CI/notebook files in the 32-file diff; no CI runs --elastic-services; Ludus pinned to a foreign branch/path; profile matrix asserted by nothing.

findings.title: network isolation test asserts up not blocked
findings.summary: test_expected_ports_accessible checks listed ports are up, never that unlisted are blocked; no loopback-tightening regression test.
